auth/bootstrap-secret.ts.boundary: Operational bootstrap secret initialization and rollback-safe latch; owner and key creation consume the secret within their audited transaction.

auth/ceiling-catchup.ts.boundary: Audited compare-and-set client scope ceiling widening; no-op creates no audit. Native rejection and concurrent single-winner controls in credential-retention-audit.test.ts.

auth/credential-adapter.ts.boundary: Provider persistence phase joins the shared SQLite transaction and retains responses until strict audit commit; generic adapter mutation methods are guarded here, with native model and lifecycle controls in credential-audit.test.ts.

auth/grant-lifecycle.ts.boundary: Audited grant creation, reuse and retirement with provider tokens/consent/device codes and optional keys under the consent lock; native trigger rollback and live-authority controls in credential-audit.test.ts and grant-inactivity-retirer.test.ts.

auth/instance.ts.boundary: Owner account and provider request persistence phases share the audited transaction after password preparation; credential-audit.test.ts covers native rejection and commit outcomes.

auth/key-reach.ts.boundary: Contained key permission and revocation cascades inside caller audited folder/key transactions; key-audit-atomicity.test.ts verifies rollback and live authority.

auth/keyed-throttle.ts.boundary: Existing operational exemption: authentication throttling counters.

auth/oauth-provider.ts.boundary: Awaited scope-refusal observation and audited inactive-grant token cleanup; provider mutations join the credential adapter transaction; credential-audit.test.ts and oauth-authorize-observability.test.ts.

bulk-actions/gc.ts.boundary: Existing operational exemption: expired completed bulk job bookkeeping, no resource changes.

bulk-actions/runner.ts.boundary: Contained subwrites: worker audited chunk owns item/tag writes, checkpoint, events and audit together; bulk-audit.test.ts.

bulk-actions/worker.ts.boundary: Audited resource-changing chunk plus checkpoint; leases/recovery/terminal status and failed-only checkpoints are operational. bulk-audit.test.ts and recovery-sweep.test.ts.

enrichment/sweeper.ts.boundary: Audited system enrichment unit contains item event and enrichment result; external-audit.test.ts.

housekeeping/blob-delete.ts.boundary: Audited logical copy deletion/purge claims and settlements, external bytes outside writer; external-audit.test.ts.

housekeeping/blob-integrity.ts.boundary: Audited missing/corrupt copy registry changes; verified-at bookkeeping is operational; external-audit.test.ts.

housekeeping/blob-orphans.ts.boundary: Existing operational mark-and-sweep observation retains orphan detection timestamps; no blob removal here. Actual removal is audited in blob-delete.

housekeeping/blob-replicate.ts.boundary: Audited registry copy publication after external I/O; external-audit.test.ts.

housekeeping/registrations.ts.boundary: Existing operational retention of audit/event/idempotency/inbound/delivery logs; deleting the audit trail does not recursively audit itself.

housekeeping/scheduler.ts.boundary: Existing operational exemption: scheduler leases, due times and run results.

middleware/auth.ts.boundary: Existing operational exemption: credential last-used stamps only; credential lifecycle changes use the audited provider boundary.

middleware/idempotency.ts.boundary: Existing operational exemption: request ownership and response replay cache.

middleware/rate-limit.ts.boundary: Existing operational exemption: request rate counters.

pubsub.ts.boundary: Contained subwrite: durable event append runs inside resource transaction; live delivery releases after commit.

routes/_edges-inline.ts.boundary: Contained edge subwrites under item create/update audited unit; audit-atomicity.test.ts.

routes/admin-archive-types.ts.boundary: Audited bounded schema preparation unit; committed preparation remains truthfully recorded when later restore fails; external-audit.test.ts.

routes/admin-archive.ts.boundary: Audited blob preparation and final item/metadata/history/edge restore unit; date and history finalization joins the row transaction. Native failure coverage in external-audit.test.ts and archive-complete-roundtrip.test.ts.

routes/admin-platform-types.ts.boundary: Audited platform type removal, registry settlement inside transaction; admin-platform-types.test.ts.

routes/auth-consent.ts.boundary: Audited consent approval and silent reuse contain provider consent, token and grant projection changes under the consent lock; credential-audit.test.ts and auth-consent-skip.test.ts.

routes/auth-pages.ts.boundary: Audited device approval contains consent, narrowed code and grant projection; shared audited grant revocation handles security disconnect. credential-audit.test.ts and device-grant.test.ts.

routes/blobs.ts.boundary: Audited uploader/registry publication after staged bytes; external-audit.test.ts.

routes/bulk.ts.boundary: Audited atomic page, each best-effort entry, enqueue and changed cancellation; no-op entries have no record; bulk-audit.test.ts.

routes/connector-state.ts.boundary: Audited explicit state clear; existing connector contract exempts holds, checkpoint documents and agreements from audit; audit-atomicity.test.ts.

routes/connectors.ts.boundary: Audited registration, removal and inbound endpoint changes; heartbeats/run reports/receipt handling are existing operational exemptions; audit-atomicity.test.ts.

routes/edges-bulk.ts.boundary: Audited atomic page and each best-effort changed entry; bulk-audit.test.ts.

routes/edges.ts.boundary: Audited edge create/update/delete, acknowledged duplicate has no new record; audit-atomicity.test.ts.

routes/export.ts.boundary: Standalone strict observation audit before opening stream, no writer held across stream; external-audit.test.ts.

routes/extensions.ts.boundary: Audited extension write/delete with metadata event; audit-atomicity.test.ts.

routes/folders.ts.boundary: Audited folder create/update/delete unit includes key permission cascades; audit-atomicity.test.ts and key-audit-atomicity.test.ts.

routes/health-probes.ts.boundary: Operational liveness probe: one settings row, rewritten at most every ten seconds to show a write commits, not a resource mutation door; health.test.ts, health.app.test.ts.

routes/inbound.ts.boundary: Existing operational exemption: ingress rate accounting and received delivery spool; endpoint configuration is audited in connectors.ts.

routes/items-lifecycle.ts.boundary: Audited restore/transition with cascades and events; audit-atomicity.test.ts.

routes/items.ts.boundary: Audited create/update/delete/purge/tag/metadata units; acknowledgement without mutation adds no record; audit-atomicity.test.ts.

routes/keys.ts.boundary: Audited create/update/revoke and atomic bootstrap claim/secret consumption; hashing outside writer and raw key released only after confirmed commit. key-audit-atomicity.test.ts and bootstrap-audit-outcome.test.ts.

routes/owner.ts.boundary: Owner creation delegates to the credential transaction after password hashing, including bootstrap claim and secret consumption; credential-audit.test.ts covers native audit failure and commit outcomes.

routes/types.ts.boundary: Audited type create/update/delete and registry settlement; audit-atomicity.test.ts.

routes/webhooks.ts.boundary: Audited subscription and owned failed-delivery redelivery transitions; no audit on duplicate/refusal; audit-atomicity.test.ts.

storage/audited-transaction.ts.boundary: Shared strict transactional audit insertion and positive durable commit witness; audited-transaction.test.ts.

storage/blob-layer.ts.boundary: Audited changed store attachment/detachment after all external attachment succeeds; unchanged startup is a no-op; blob-layer.test.ts.

storage/instance-config.ts.boundary: Contained settings write under config route audited transaction; audit-atomicity.test.ts.

storage/instance-id.ts.boundary: Existing operational bootstrap of the stable instance identifier, not a resource mutation door.

storage/item-write.ts.boundary: Contained item/cascade/metadata primitives; event/version/index work joins the caller audited domain or credential transaction.

storage/retention.ts.boundary: Audited bounded trash/grant/key/client purge and shared audited inactive grant retirement; expired session and rate-record cleanup remain operational. credential-retention-audit.test.ts and grant-inactivity-retirer.test.ts.

storage/version-thinner.ts.boundary: Audited bounded system version removal; external-audit.test.ts.

webhooks/delivery.ts.boundary: Existing operational exemption: automatic scheduling, cursor, attempt lease and accepted delivery outcomes; user-requested redelivery audited in routes/webhooks.ts.
